title: Theognosis RTT Session Schema
description: Canonical schema for a single RTT observation session. One session = one model × one time-step sequence (T-01 to T-10). Aggregate fields in this schema feed models.json derived values. Operator output structures mirror t_OperatorMap.md §10.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this session. Generate as UUID v4.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of session start (when T-01 was recorded).

model_id.description: Must match an 'id' field in models.json.

model_label.description: Human-readable label from models.json for quick reference.

session_context.description: RTT session anchor — must match declared context for this research phase.

drift.description: Drift class — must match model's drift_class in models.json.

scaffolded.description: True if any cycle data in this session contains placeholder/estimated values rather than real observations. Must be false before session data may feed models.json aggregate fields.

time_labels.description: Ordered sequence of time-step labels. Must be exactly 10 items for a standard session.

cycles.description: Ordered array of RTT cycles — one per time-step. Length must match time_labels.

session_notes.description: Optional freeform notes for this session. Not used in computation.

cycle_record.description: A single RTT evaluation cycle at one time-step. Maps to one row in the sessions log and one data point in aggregate series.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this cycle was evaluated.

step.description: Time-step label — must match the corresponding entry in session.time_labels.

regime.description: Declared Regime active for this cycle. Determines primary operator affinity per t_OperatorMap.md §9.

operator_declared.description: Operator designated by the Declared Regime for this cycle. Flui may never be declared — see t_OperatorMap.md §6.2.

operator_collapsed.description: Operator that actually collapsed. Null if cycle failed without collapse. May differ from operator_declared if escalation occurred.

oneOf.description: Null if cycle failed with no collapse.

flui_wrapped.description: True if Flui wrapped the operator output at L3. Requires regime_permits_wrapping = true and successful prior collapse.

flui_emission.description: Natural language emission from Flui wrapping, if flui_wrapped = true. Null otherwise.

vp_flagged.description: True if this cycle triggered a Validator Pulse review. See t_ValidatorPulse.md for VP behavior.

error_flags.description: List of error codes raised during this cycle. Empty array = clean cycle. See t_OperatorMap.md for flag definitions.

escalation_record.description: Records an operator escalation within a cycle. Maximum one escalation per cycle.

from_operator.description: Operator that encountered a blocking error.

trigger_flag.description: The error flag that triggered escalation.

to_operator.description: Operator that took over after escalation.

freqi_output.description: Output from Freqi — categorical selection. See t_OperatorMap.md §3.3.

choice.description: The selected option identifier from the bounded option set.

confidence.description: Collapse confidence after L2 clarity coefficient application.

option_count.description: Number of options in the bounded set at time of collapse.

aurion_output.description: Output from Aurion — scalar emission. See t_OperatorMap.md §4.3.

score.description: Emitted scalar value. Must fall within declared range after L2 normalization.

axis.description: Named measurement axis declared by the Regime.

range.description: Declared [min, max] bounds for this axis.

forci_output.description: Output from Forci — binary decision. See t_OperatorMap.md §5.3.

polarity.description: Declared polarity of the true state.

tension.description: Polarity tension at moment of collapse. Values > 0.95 trigger FORCI_NEAR_PARITY and VP review.

flui_output.description: Output from Flui — linguistic wrapping at L3 only. See t_OperatorMap.md §6.4.

wraps.description: The operator whose output Flui is wrapping.

source_output.description: The prior operator output being wrapped. Must be one of freqi_output, aurion_output, or forci_output.

emission.description: Natural language string wrapping the structured output.

regime_permits_wrapping.description: Must be true for Flui to emit. If false, Flui is blocked and FLUI_REGIME_BLOCKED is raised.

dimension_snapshot.description: Per-cycle snapshot of raw dimension readings before collapse. Used to compute aggregate RTT variance and wobble. All values are floats in declared measurement range.

Freqi.description: Raw Freqi resonance reading at this time-step.

Aurion.description: Raw Aurion resonance reading at this time-step.

Forci.description: Raw Forci resonance reading at this time-step.

Flui.description: Raw Flui resonance reading at this time-step. Captured even when Flui is suppressed at L1.

aggregate_metrics.description: Computed aggregate metrics derived from the cycles array. These values are what get written back to models.json after a session completes with scaffolded=false.

rtt_variance.description: RTT variance score per dimension across all 10 cycles. Computed as variance of dimension_snapshot values. Range 0–100.

entropy_series.description: Entropy stability reading per time-step T-01 through T-10. Lower = more stable. Computed from cross-dimension variance at each step.

wobble.description: Scalar wobble amplitude per dimension — standard deviation of dimension_snapshot values across 10 steps.

flip_rate.description: Polarity flip-rate per dimension, expressed as flips per 100 cycles. Forci is the primary source (actual polarity flips). Freqi, Aurion, Flui values are inferred from categorical/scalar polarity reversals.

drift_series.description: Drift turbulence index per time-step T-01 through T-10. Computed from cumulative operator tension and error flag density at each step.

cycle_count.description: Number of cycles completed in this session. Always 10 for a standard session.

clean_cycle_count.description: Cycles with zero error_flags and vp_flagged = false.

vp_flagged_count.description: Number of cycles that triggered Validator Pulse review.

escalation_count.description: Number of cycles that required operator escalation.

mean_confidence.description: Mean collapse confidence across all completed cycles.

clarity_coefficient.description: Session-level clarity coefficient — ratio of clean cycles to total cycles, weighted by mean confidence. Feeds RLCD calibration in t_ValidatorPulse.md.

vp_summary.description: Validator Pulse summary for this session. Populated if any cycle was VP-flagged. See t_ValidatorPulse.md.

vp_triggered.description: True if VP was triggered at any point in this session.

flagged_cycles.description: List of cycle_ids that triggered VP review.

vp_verdict.description: Overall VP verdict for the session. N/A if vp_triggered = false.
